added_models.model: Loncastuximab QSP model with LOTIS-2-derived virtual patients (CD19 surface density vs response)

efficacy.note: QSP model of lonca response by CD19 density first shown at ASH Dec 2022; built on LOTIS-2 patients, so any match is retrodictive.
efficacy.quote: Quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) modelling was used to predict Lonca responses.
efficacy.confidence_note: Opener dated to the ASH 2022 poster (adctmedical.com PDF, not read in full); quote from the 2023 paper abstract as proxy.
efficacy.population: R/R DLBCL (LOTIS-2), by tumour CD19 expression
efficacy.judgement: Opener at the model's first public showing. The opener carries retrodiction false because the lint scores a retrodiction only as retro or contra; the next entry flags it.

efficacy.note: Virtual patients respond down to ~1000 CD19/cell, reproducing LOTIS-2 responses across all IHC CD19 levels.
efficacy.short: Reproduces response regardless of IHC CD19
efficacy.quote: QSP modelling predicted that CD19 expression by immunohistochemistry alone does not predict Lonca response, whereas inclusion of CD19 surface density improved response prediction.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. Virtual population generated from LOTIS-2 patients (Metrum ACCP 2023 poster), so retrodiction.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: response vs CD19 IHC level (patient selection)
efficacy.population: R/R DLBCL (LOTIS-2), by tumour CD19 expression
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level prediction (does CD19 level pick responders). Built on and compared with LOTIS-2 after its results were public (2021), so retro, not same.

added_models.model: Human lymphoma cell-line panel with graded CD19 expression, in vitro loncastuximab cytotoxicity

efficacy.note: Six lymphoma lines spanning CD19 levels tested for lonca cytotoxicity to ask whether CD19 level selects responders; run after LOTIS-2.
efficacy.quote: Lonca cytotoxicity was evaluated in a panel of six lymphoma cell lines with various CD19 expression levels.
efficacy.confidence_note: Opener dated to the ASH 2022 poster as proxy; quote from the 2023 paper abstract.
efficacy.population: R/R DLBCL (LOTIS-2), by tumour CD19 expression
efficacy.judgement: In vitro cell lines have no exact model_kind; ex_vivo is the nearest enum value.

efficacy.note: Lonca killed lines at all CD19 levels including a very-low line, matching LOTIS-2 responses in CD19-low/negative patients.
efficacy.short: Low-CD19 lines killed, as in patients
efficacy.quote: Similarly, Lonca induced cytotoxicity in cell lines with different levels of CD19 expression, including one with very low expression.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. Tarantelli 2024 (60 lines) found in vitro activity correlated with CD19 level, a nuance not scored here.
efficacy.population: R/R DLBCL (LOTIS-2), by tumour CD19 expression
efficacy.judgement: The paper sets cell-line and patient results side by side ('Similarly'), so comparison_stated; run after LOTIS-2 reported, so retro.

considered_not_added: Al-Katib 2009 SAR3419 WSU-DLCL2/WSU-FSCCL SCID xenograft: same system as the draft's sar3419-lymphoma-xenograft track (checker asks to swap its model_src from Blanc 2011); not a new track.
Coltuximab Ramos xenograft minimal effective dose (~50 ug/kg DM4; Mol Pharm 2015, PMID 25856201): same xenograft system as sar3419-lymphoma-xenograft; no stated human-dose comparison found.
Tisagenlecleucel cellular-kinetic model (Stein 2019) and kinetics/dose analysis in JULIET (Awasthi 2020 Blood Adv): fitted to patient data, no prospective prediction compared with DLBCL outcomes.
CAR-T QSP / PK-PD models (Mueller-Schoell 2021 Cancers; Pomeroy 2026; Kirouac 2024 review): not specific to a member drug in DLBCL or no stated comparison with tisagenlecleucel DLBCL outcomes.
Loncastuximab population PK / exposure-response (BLA 761196 review): patient-derived; review says dose selection was based on clinical safety and efficacy, not a model.

Tarantelli 2024 Haematologica 60-line lymphoma panel (in vitro activity correlated with CD19 level): no stated comparison with patient response; patients were measured by IHC, the panel by surface expression, so a pairing would be ambiguous.
hCD19 transgenic mouse (Gallagher/MEDI-551) and cynomolgus tox: already tracked in the draft (medi551-hucd19-cd20-tg-mouse, medi551-nonclinical-tox).
Patient-derived DLBCL xenografts, ex vivo patient-cell sensitivity, or human genetic models for any member: none found with a patient comparison.
Kymriah CBER review (BLA 125646 DLBCL supplement): not in the bundle and not fetched; any lymphoma xenograft it names is unverified.
Tafasitamab and axicabtagene/lisocabtagene: CD19 depleters outside the tile's member list.
